{"effort": "high", "extra": {}, "messages": [["user", "## Scenario

Cross-national news consumption habits and media trust survey across five OECD nations, 2021–2024

An international media observatory and comparative research network conducted periodic population-weighted survey waves between January 2021 and December 2024 across five countries. The research tracks shifting reliance on digital channels versus traditional broadcasting, audience trust in primary information sources, and weekly engagement intensity.

## Columns

| Column | Kind | Declared as |
|---|---|---|
| `age_group` | category | 18-24, 25-34, 35-54, 55+; ordered=ordinal; group demographics |
| `country` | category | United States, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Japan; group geography |
| `main_news_source` | category | Social Media, Online News Sites, Television, Printed Press, Radio; within age_group; group demographics |
| `news_frequency_per_day` | measure | unit check-ins; additive |
| `quarter` | category | 2021-Q1, 2021-Q2, 2021-Q3, 2021-Q4, 2022-Q1, 2022-Q2, 2022-Q3, 2022-Q4, 2023-Q1, 2023-Q2, 2023-Q3, 2023-Q4, and 4 more; ordered=ordinal; derived from survey_date; group calendar |
| `survey_date` | time | 2021-01-01 to 2024-12-31, monthly; group calendar |
| `trust_score` | measure | unit points; non-additive |
| `weekly_news_hours` | measure | unit hours; additive |

    p0: bar, grouped by main_news_source, AVG(trust_score), unit points
